==About==

0-5x {{i|Pine Nut}}s are received when Removing Cone Scales from {{i|Pinecone}}s and {{i|Spruce Cone}}s. {{i|Roasted Pine Nuts}} are obtained when using a Pine Nut with the {{i|Roasted Nuts}} recipe. A Pine Nut can be stored in a {{i|NutSack}}.
